facts.raw_span: painless right testicular swelling of several weeks’ duration
without systemic symptoms
glaucoma, prostatic adenomectomy, and hernioplasty
dorzolamide, lansoprazole, and dutasteride
enlargement and inhomogeneity of the right testis and epididymis with ipsilateral hydrocele
swelling persisted after 10 days of amoxicillin–clavulanate
bilateral macronodular adrenal enlargement measuring 15×12 mm on the right and 27×18 mm on the left
these nodules were absent on a CT scan 3 years earlier
intense uptake (SUVmax 25.5) in the right testis
no uptake in the adrenal glands
normal electrolytes, blood count, iron studies, protein electrophoresis, glucose, renal and liver function, thyroid profile, LDH, and β2-microglobulin
negative for active HCV and EBV (positive for past EBV)

concepts.why: The patient has painless testicular swelling with intense uptake on PET/CT, which is suggestive of testicular lymphoma.
The patient has bilateral macronodular adrenal enlargement, which is consistent with adrenal adenoma.
The patient has enlargement and inhomogeneity of the right testis and epididymis, which is consistent with epididymitis.
The patient has testicular swelling with intense uptake on PET/CT and adrenal enlargement, which is suggestive of testicular cancer with adrenal metastasis.
The patient has bilateral macronodular adrenal enlargement, which is consistent with adrenal incidentaloma.
The patient has testicular swelling and epididymis enlargement, which is consistent with orchitis.
The patient has painless testicular swelling with intense uptake on PET/CT, which is suggestive of lymphoma with testicular involvement.
The patient has bilateral macronodular adrenal enlargement, which is consistent with adrenal cyst.
It explains the absence of uptake in the adrenal glands on the 18 FDG PET/CT scan.

rationales.F01: Painless testicular swelling is more typical of testicular lymphoma or cancer than epididymitis or orchitis.
rationales.F05: Enlargement and inhomogeneity of the testis is highly suggestive of testicular lymphoma or cancer.
rationales.F06: Persistence of swelling after antibiotic treatment suggests a non-infectious cause.
rationales.F07: Bilateral macronodular adrenal enlargement is suggestive of adrenal metastasis or primary adrenal lymphoma.
rationales.F09: Intense uptake in the right testis on PET/CT is highly suggestive of testicular lymphoma or cancer.
